title: fix(app-shell,data-objectstack): Studio stops probing expected misses as errors (objectui#11799)
body:
Refs #11799 (legs 1 and 3 land whole; leg 2 lands for the Interfaces and Automations pillars, and the Data pillar's `/layers` read of a never-published object stays: see Acceptance notes)
Clause-②: no

Studio asked three questions whose expected answer is an error, so the browser console filled with red lines that hide real failures. This PR stops each one at the client, from answers the client already gets with a 200.

## What changed

**Leg 1. Draft existence comes from the drafts ledger.** `MetadataClient.getDraft()` (data-objectstack) now reads `GET /meta/_drafts` first, through `listDrafts()`, the shared in-flight read objectui#11797 made. It sends `GET /meta/:type/:name?state=draft` only when the ledger lists the name.
- It still resolves `null` for no draft and the raw envelope for a draft. No caller changes.
- A draft saved a moment ago is found. A write through the transport drops the pending ledger read when it lands (`sendWrite`), so a question asked after a save never joins a read sent before it.
- An unreadable ledger (403 without an authoring capability, 501 on a kernel without drafts, a network fault) counts as unknown, not empty, and the item read is sent as before.
- The ledger is read whole and matched by name. The `?state=draft` read finds a row under either spelling of the type, and with a package it finds that package's row or the package-less one. The ledger's `type` and `packageId` filters are exact, so a filtered ledger could miss a draft the item read serves. The editor would then open the published body over a pending draft. Unfiltered, a miss is a real absence, and a same-name row of another type only costs the item read that was always sent.
- This sits in the client rather than the Studio caller, so every `getDraft` caller stops logging the 404: Studio's four loads, the Access pillar's OWD overview, `ResourceEditPage`, `PermissionMatrixEditor` and the hooks panel.

**Leg 2. The published baseline is read only when it is used.** In `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`:
- The Interfaces leaf load and the Automations flow load read the draft first, and read `GET /meta/:type/:name/layers` only for an item with no pending draft. That is the one case those loads use the baseline: a served draft is taken as-is (objectui#10765). An item that was never saved always has a draft, so it no longer asks `/layers`, which answers 404 for a name with no layer.
- The Interfaces app load reads no `/layers` for an app the published list does not hold. That app was found in the ledger, so it has never been saved. The published list is read in the same effect run, so it is current.

**Leg 3. No usage read while AI is off.** `AiUsageIndicator` reads `GET /ai/usage` only while the agent catalog at its own base (`GET {apiBase}/agents`) lists an agent. That catalog is the signal `useAiSurfaceEnabled` gates every AI entry point on. Its header explains why it is not discovery's `services.ai`: that flag is the same for every user, and a seat-less user must see AI as off. The catalog read is shared with the dock's own, because `useAgents` keeps one request per base in flight and caches its answer.

No REST answer, export, prop, type member or language-pack key changes.

## Measured before editing (mechanism hypotheses)

- **H1, confirmed.** Every Studio item load calls `getDraft()` beside `layered()` in a `Promise.all`, and `readItemResponse` turns the 404 into `null`. There are four such loads: the Interfaces app and leaf loads, the Data pillar object load and the Automations flow load. Since objectui#11797, `listDrafts()` and `readItemResponse` go through `shareRead`, and `sendWrite` clears it. `usePendingDrafts`' raw-fetch ledger read is cleared only by the publish pulse, not by a draft save. So that read would report a just-saved draft absent, and leg 1 uses the client's read instead.
- **H2, falsified.** `LayeredDiff.tsx` fetches nothing. It renders a `layered` prop. The `/layers` reads come from the same four Studio loads (and from `ResourceEditPage`, `EmbeddedItemEditor`, `PermissionMatrixEditor` and `PackageOwdOverviewPanel` outside Studio's loads). The server answers 404 when no layer exists at all (`createMetaLayeredAnswer`, reason `absent`), which describes a draft-only item.
- **H3, partly falsified.** `useAiUsage` has no interval. It reads on mount, on the chat engine's refresh event and on tab re-focus. The repeated 501 comes from mounts: the Studio dock is drawn while the agent catalog loads, so the indicator mounts and reads once per dock mount. On an open-edition server the framework answers `/ai/agents` with its empty-list courtesy and every other `/ai/*` route with 501 (`handleAIRequest`).

## Network reading, before and after

This is a dev-only harness, never committed. It mounts the real pillars over a real `MetadataClient` whose transport is an in-memory server: 404 for `?state=draft` with no draft and for `/layers` with no layer, 501 for `/ai/*` except `/ai/agents`. Each pillar opens one saved item, then one draft-only item.

| Surface | before: requests / 404-501 | after: requests / 404-501 |
|---|---|---|
| Interfaces (app, saved leaf, draft-only leaf) | 9 / 3 | 9 / 0 |
| Data (saved object, draft-only object) | 6 / 2 | 7 / 1 |
| Automations (saved flow, draft-only flow) | 7 / 2 | 7 / 0 |
| Studio AI dock, open edition | 2 / 1 | 1 / 0 |

The misses before were the app, leaf, object and flow `?state=draft` reads; the draft-only leaf, object and flow `/layers` reads; and `/ai/usage`. The one miss after is the Data pillar's `/layers` for the draft-only object (see Acceptance notes).

## Pins

- `packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.draftLedger-11799.test.ts`: no draft means no `?state=draft`; a listed draft gets exactly one; a draft saved a moment ago is found (a held ledger read, a save that lands, a new ledger read for the later question); control: with no write in between, the question joins the pending read; 403, 501 and a network fault send the item read; a package-less row and a plural-spelling row still lead to the item read; questions asked together share one ledger read.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.expectedMisses-11799.test.tsx`: the real pillars over a real client. A saved leaf or flow with no draft makes no `?state=draft` request, and an unsaved one makes one and no `/layers` request. A draft saved a moment ago is found when the leaf is reopened. A ledger-only app reads no `/layers`; control: a published app does. The Data pillar asks no draft of a saved object.
- `packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/AiUsageIndicator.aiOff-11799.test.tsx`: with an empty catalog, `/ai/usage` is never requested, on mount or after a refresh event or re-focus. Nothing is read while the catalog loads. Control: with an agent, usage is read on mount and again on a nudge.
- Updated: `metadata-client.get-envelope.test.ts` A10 (its server now answers the ledger) and `AiUsageIndicator.test.tsx` (its cases are an AI-on viewer, so the catalog hook is stubbed to list one agent).

**Reverse check, per leg.** Each leg's source file was reverted to the base `31add5ff`, and the reverted blob hash was checked equal to the base blob. That leg's pins were run, then the file was restored from `HEAD`, the restored hash was checked equal to `HEAD`'s, and `git diff HEAD` was confirmed empty. Run on `a473d14`, leg 3 re-run on `bee4e1b`:
- Leg 1 (`metadata-client.ts`): 16 of 27 failed, each in the predicted direction. For example, the received URL list was the bare `?state=draft` read instead of the ledger, and the Studio pins received a `?state=draft` 404 for the saved leaf and the saved object.
- Leg 2 (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`): 4 of 6 failed: `/layers` read for the unsaved leaf, the ledger-only app and the unsaved flow, and a second `/layers` for the reopened leaf with a draft. The Data pillar row and the published-app control stayed green, as predicted.
- Leg 3 (`AiUsageIndicator.tsx`): 2 of 3 failed. The empty-catalog case received 2 usage reads where 0 is expected. The loading case failed at its precondition, because the base never reads the catalog. The control stayed green.

## Gates (local, on `b34f4f5`, after merging `origin/main` at `bfca7ec`)

- `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2` (the closure of both touched packages): exit 0, 28/28 tasks.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/data-objectstack type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (with `tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. The data-objectstack program lists both of its touched test files.
- `vitest run` over `packages/data-objectstack/` and 282 app-shell files: everything under `studio-design/`, `layout/` and `hooks/`, every app-shell test naming `getDraft`, `new MetadataClient(`, `useAiUsage` or `AiUsageIndicator`, and `viewCacheInvalidation.guard.test.tsx`, the only guard test in either package. Result: 364 files, 3084 tests passed, exit 0.
- `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: all exit 0.
- Declared narrowing: the rest of app-shell's 1121 test files and the repo-wide `pnpm lint` are CI's.

## Risk and cost

- Opening an Interfaces leaf or an Automations flow now waits for the ledger before it reads the item. That is one round trip more than the parallel reads it replaces, and it is the price of deciding from the ledger. The app load keeps its parallel reads.
- A `getDraft` of an item that has a draft is now two requests: the ledger, then the item. Questions asked together share one ledger read, so the lints and the hooks panel pay one extra request per batch.
- Rollback: revert this PR. The client and the three loads are independent, and nothing persisted changes shape.

## Acceptance notes

- **The Data pillar still reads `/layers` for a never-published object** (one 404 per open, in the table above). There, the read is the question itself. Its answer sets `hasBaseline` (no records table yet, so no data query) and the published field projection, and both are used even with a draft. Nothing the pillar holds answers either for certain. Its rail's package-scoped published list goes stale across a publish: the rail re-reads on the refresh pulse while the load re-runs on `publishNonce`, and taking that list as "never saved" would show a just-published object as unpublished. Routes: carry a published bit the load can trust, or accept the 404 there. This needs the seat's call, and is why the first line says Refs.
- **Other `/layers` reads of a draft-only item outside the claimed surface**, which this PR leaves alone: `PackageOwdOverviewPanel.tsx` (its load and save reads), `ObjectListViewInspector.tsx` (new from objectui#11823, which reads `/layers` for a list view that may not exist yet), and `ResourceEditPage.tsx`, `EmbeddedItemEditor.tsx` and `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` in Setup. Their `?state=draft` 404s are gone through leg 1.
- The suggested route said "the `_drafts` list for the package". This PR reads the whole ledger, for the measured reason in leg 1: a package or type filter is narrower than the item read it replaces.
